title: RETHINKING AI CULTURAL ALIGNMENT
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything specific to faith/religion. It measured 'cultural alignment' based on responses to general survey questions across different nationalities.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study.
